---
title: Recap slides
description: How an integration joins the year in review.
sidebar: { order: 6 }
---

The [year in review](/concepts/recap/) is built from what each integration offers. Return `recap` beside `widgets`. It gets the period, and answers with slides.

```js
async recap({ year, from, to }) {
  const n = await countThings(from, to);
  if (!n) return [];                     // nothing to say? say nothing
  return [{
    id: 'things',
    kicker: 'You made',
    value: n.toLocaleString('en'),
    unit: 'things',
    scope: 'year',
    line: 'One sentence on why that matters.',
    stat: 'Things made',
    score: 60,
    trait: { name: 'The Maker', line: 'Who this makes them.', strength: 0.6 },
  }];
}
```

`from` and `to` are milliseconds. `to` stops at now, so a year in progress is covered up to today. A recap that takes longer than 25 seconds or throws is left out, and the rest go on.

No model writes any of this. A paper full of real numbers can't have one inventing a few.

## Rules

- **Only real numbers.** If your service can't really know something, leave it out.
- **Say what it covers.** `scope` is `'year'`, or what the number covers: `'All time'`, `'Last 30 days'`. Left out, it's `'Right now'`. A slide that doesn't say doesn't get to claim the year.
- **An empty value is dropped.**
- **Mark `private: true` if it names people.** It stays off the shareable card unless chosen.

## tally

Most services can only say a count. In a built-in `service()`, `tally(count, slide)` makes the usual slide from one number, and nothing at all when it's zero.

```ts
import { service, tally } from '../../server/service.ts';

recap: d => tally(d.stats.total, { id: 'code', theme: 'code', icon: 'file', kicker: 'Your own forge holds', unit: 'repositories', stat: 'Repositories', line: 'On hardware you run.' }),
```

It sets `value` from the number, `score: 55` and `scope: 'Right now'`. You can override the scope.

`tally` isn't in the plugin toolkit. In a plugin, write the slide yourself:

```js
recap: d => d.stats.total > 0 ? [{ id: 'code', theme: 'code', value: d.stats.total.toLocaleString('en'), score: 55, scope: 'Right now', kicker: 'Your own forge holds', unit: 'repositories', stat: 'Repositories', line: 'On hardware you run.' }] : [],
```

A `service()` gets its app icon on the slide without asking, unless the slide brings its own art.

## How slides are chosen

Valet keeps up to 3 slides per theme from each service and 4 per theme overall, sorted by `score`. The short story is up to eight slides, the richest first. A slide with a chart, artwork or a trait beats a bare count, and neighbours never share a theme. The rest wait behind "Explore everything".

## Slide fields

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| `id` | Required. |
| `kicker` | Required. The small line above: "You watched". |
| `value` | Required. The big one. A plain number counts up. |
| `line` | Required. A sentence on why it's interesting. |
| `unit` | Beside the value. |
| `scope` | `'year'`, or what it covers. |
| `score` | Higher comes earlier. 50 by default. |
| `theme` | One of `media`, `music`, `reading`, `food`, `home`, `network`, `reach`, `security`, `files`, `ops`, `code`, `ai`, `hardware`, `games`. |
| `stat` | Its label on the shareable card, if it belongs there. |
| `private` | It names people. |
| `trait` | `{ name, line, strength }`. Who this makes you, 0 to 1. The strongest across all services wins. |
| `icon` | A small icon. |
| `logo` | The app's icon, large, tinting the slide with its colours. |
| `items` | A top five: `{ name, value, image }`. |
| `bars` | A small chart of what the number is made of: `{ label, value, show }`. |
| `chart` | Progress: `{ pct, from, to, mark }`. |
| `race` | The top titles overtaking each other. |
| `backdrop` | Wide artwork, full bleed. |
| `wall` | The drifting wall of posters behind it. |
| `art` | Posters to add to that wall. |
| `show` | A wall of this slide's own pictures: `{ images, shape, soft }`. |
| `icons` | A wall of app icons. |
| `visual` | A live 3D model: `{ kind, data }`, where `kind` is `home` or `pc-case`. |
| `facts` | Raw numbers, so slides can be written across services. |
